_about: Hand-curated achievements. One entry per real accomplishment. 'canonical' is the bare-bone bullet held to the Resume 1 length band (p10–p90 of R1 = 97–167 chars, hard ceiling 170). 'variants' are angle-specific rewrites; the 'longform' variant is the Section C (Business Consulting Engagements) wording, held to its own band (ceiling 340). 'patterns' are regexes (case-insensitive) that assign every raw bullet in sources/raw_extract.json to this achievement; ingest fails if any raw bullet matches nothing. 'confidence': verified (consistent across sources) | asserted (single source) | conflict (sources disagree — see notes).
